title: Father and Children in Winter Attire, 1920s Urban B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A crisp outdoor family portrait taken along a city sidewalk next to a stone building stoop. The father stands tall wearing a wool overcoat and a fedora, with his hand gently resting on the shoulder of his young daughter, who wears a heavy dark coat with light fur or shearling trim and a matching cloche hat. To the left, an older boy poses formally in a double-breasted suit jacket, necktie, knickerbockers, tall dark stockings, and a tam or beret. The attire reflects quintessential late 1920s urban middle-class style.
